approved_product_claim: After a browser records a submitted reissue-fulfillment signature, any resume path inspects that exact signature and reconciles its exact saved envelope; it does not submit a second transaction, and an exact finalized hosted replay does not append a second state event.
grants: eligibility to author a separate deployment candidate
eligibility to author a separate live interruption-test candidate
currentness_check: candidate record, product-test receipt, and all material bytes matched their frozen digests immediately before this decision was recorded
claim_ceiling: The exact tested product candidate is product-approved. Every operational effect remains subject to a separate immutable candidate and explicit authorization.
